1. If God exists, then God is omnipotent.
2’. If something is omnipotent, it can bring about any possible situation.
3. If God exists, then God can bring about any possible situation. (1,2)
4. If God exists, then God is wholly good.
5*. If something is wholly good, it always eliminates as much pointless evil as it can.
6. If God exists, then God eliminates as much pointless evil as God can. (4,5)
7. If God exists, then God eliminates all pointless evil that it is possible to eliminate. (3,6)
8. If God exists, then there is no pointless evil that it is possible to eliminate. (7)
9*. Some pointless evil that it is possible to eliminate exists.
C. God does not exist. (8,9)
